item.title: Why does C have the best file API
item.description:
Loading a file can cause code execution even if you just wanted some numbers. File manipulation is similarly neglected. This simply isn't true on memory constrained systems — and with 100 GB files — every system is memory constrained.

HN Discussion

Read Original Article

Top 1 Comments:

FrankWilhoit:

A file API is not the same thing as a filesystem API. The holy grail is still a universal but high(-enough)-level filesystem API.
